system.name: Space Fractions
system.description: Web-based, interactive learning tool to improve fraction-solving skills for sixth-grade students.

diagrams.name: UseCaseDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml UseCaseDiagram
left to right direction
actor EndUser as "End User"
actor Admin as "Admin"
rectangle System {
  usecase "Play Game" as (PlayGame)
  usecase "View Score" as (ViewScore)
  usecase "Update Questions" as (UpdateQuestions)
  usecase "View Help" as (ViewHelp)
}
EndUser -- (PlayGame)
EndUser -- (ViewScore)
EndUser -- (ViewHelp)
Admin -- (UpdateQuestions)
@enduml

diagrams.name: ClassDiagram
ObjectDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml ObjectDiagram
participant game1
participant question1
participant user1
participant admin1
game1 --> question1
user1 --> game1
admin1 --> question1
@enduml

diagrams.name: StateDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml StateDiagram
state Playing
state Paused
state GameOver
[*] --> Playing
Playing --> Paused : pause()
Paused --> Playing : resume()
Playing --> GameOver : gameOver()
@enduml

diagrams.name: ActivityDiagram
SequenceDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml SequenceDiagram1
participant User
participant Game
participant Question
User->>Game: play()
Game->>Question: getPrompt()
Question->>Game: return prompt
Game->>User: display prompt
User->>Game: submit answer
Game->>Question: check answer
Question->>Game: return result
Game->>User: display result
@enduml
@startuml SequenceDiagram2
participant Admin
participant Question
Admin->>Question: update()
Question->>Admin: return success
@enduml

diagrams.name: CollaborationDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml CollaborationDiagram1
participant User
participant Game
participant Question
User->>Game: play()
Game->>Question: getPrompt()
Question->>Game: return prompt
Game->>User: display prompt
User->>Game: submit answer
Game->>Question: check answer
Question->>Game: return result
Game->>User: display result
note right of Game: Scenario: Play Game
@enduml
@startuml CollaborationDiagram2
participant Admin
participant Question
Admin->>Question: update()
Question->>Admin: return success
note right of Question: Scenario: Update Questions
@enduml

diagrams.name: PackageDiagram
ComponentDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml ComponentDiagram
artifact GameComponent
artifact QuestionComponent
artifact UserComponent
artifact AdminComponent
GameComponent -- QuestionComponent
GameComponent -- UserComponent
GameComponent -- AdminComponent
@enduml

diagrams.name: DeploymentDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml DeploymentDiagram
node GameServer
node QuestionServer
node UserClient
node AdminClient
GameServer -- QuestionServer
GameServer -- UserClient
GameServer -- AdminClient
@enduml

diagrams.name: ContainerDiagram
diagrams.plantuml:
@startuml ContainerDiagram
artifact GameContainer
artifact QuestionContainer
artifact UserContainer
artifact AdminContainer
GameContainer -- QuestionContainer
GameContainer -- UserContainer
GameContainer -- AdminContainer
@enduml

assumptions: The game will be played by 1000 users concurrently
The game will be played for 1 hour per session
open_questions: What is the expected user growth rate?
What is the expected game session length?
input_gaps: Traceability maps only 3 requirement(s); most of the doc's FR/NFR/ASR claims have no rows.
Test matrix in the doc is empty.
Object diagram uses sequence-diagram syntax (participant), not object syntax.
Doc contains meta sections (Analysis Plan, How to review) that are not architecture.
